The US Coast Guard is suspending its search for a medical transfer plane that mysteriously disappeared off Nantucket over the weekend, just after the agency discovered debris from the craft floating in the ocean near the Massachusetts island.

The Coast Guard made the difficult call Sunday evening, more than 40 hours after the Gulfstream G100 twinjet, carrying six passengers from Bermuda, lost contact with the Federal Aviation Administration before it was scheduled to land in Boston around 1:30 a.m.

“Suspending a search is not an easy decision,” Rear Adm. Matthew Lake, Commander of the Northeast District, said in a statement.
